description: This file contains utility functions for transforming properties related to geographic data visualization in a Superset plugin, including functions for handling geojson columns, grouping data by location, stripping geometry information, and generating chart configurations.

methods.name: getGeojsonColumns
methods.description: Identifies indices of columns containing geojson objects by parsing column names.

methods.name: createColumnName
methods.description: Creates a combined column name ignoring specified indices.

methods.name: groupByLocationGenericX
methods.description: Groups data by location based on a generic x-axis, extracting geojson columns and organizing data accordingly.

methods.name: groupByLocation
methods.description: Groups data by a specified geometry column, organizing data into location-based groups.

methods.name: stripGeomFromColnamesAndTypes
methods.description: Removes geometry information from column names and types in query data.

methods.name: stripGeomColumnFromLabelMap
methods.description: Removes geometry column references from label mappings.

methods.name: stripGeomColumnFromQueryData
methods.description: Removes geometry column data from the entire query data object.

methods.name: getChartConfigs
methods.description: Generates chart configuration objects with geographic features based on query data and chart parameters.

methods.name: parseSelectedChart
methods.description: Parses a stringified chart configuration, converting nested params from JSON strings to objects.
